Item Class: Skill Gems
Rarity: Gem
Glacial Shield Swipe
--------
Attack, Melee, AoE, Cold, Physical, Retaliation
Level: 1
Cost: 7 Mana
Cooldown Time: 3.50 sec
Attack Time: 0.70 sec
Critical Strike Chance: 5.00%
Attack Damage: 100% of base
--------
Requirements:
Level: 16
Str: 18
Dex: 26
--------
Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of ice in a cone in front of you.
--------
78 to 117 Base Off Hand Physical Damage
100% of Physical Damage Converted to Cold Damage
Cannot be used by default
Becomes Usable once for 2 seconds when you Block a Hit
17 to 25 Added Physical Damage per 15 Armour or Evasion Rating on Shield
Always Freezes enemies
Can't be Evaded
50% less Damage with Ailments
Base radius is 8 metres
--------
Experience: 1665/49725
--------
Place into an item socket to gain this skill. Right click to remove from a socket.
